question: A/An ________ is a specialist in treating cancer and providing medical care to cancer patients.
solution:
The correct answer is __**oncologist**__. 

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Oncology** is the specialized branch of medicine** dedicated to the field of cancer** including diagnosis, treatments, and research. 
 
• Doctors who treat cancer patients are called **oncologists.**
 
• The term “onco” means **bulk, mass, or tumor **while **“-logy” **means study.
 
• A clinical oncologist is a doctor who uses** chemotherapy, radiotherapy, and a range of other treatments to care for patients with cancer.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **​**A **biologist **is a researcher who conducts** research in biology. **
 
• A **Gastroenterologist **is a physician with devoted training management of diseases of the gastrointestinal tract and liver.
 
• **Psychologists** evaluate, diagnose, and treat the psychological difficulties and behavioral dysfunctions resulting from, or related to physical and mental health.
